Sensitivity analysis final script

```{r}
#cap for anomalous GPP

sites_daily_capped <- map(sites_daily, function(df) {
  cap <- quantile(df$GPP, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)
  df %>% mutate(GPP = ifelse(GPP > cap, NA, GPP))
})
```

```{r}
site_slopes <- map_dfr(names(sites_daily_capped), function(site) {
  
  df <- sites_daily_capped[[site]]
  
  binned <- df %>%
    drop_na(VPD, GPP) %>%
    mutate(vpd_bin = cut(VPD, breaks = seq(0, 6, by = 0.2))) %>%
    group_by(vpd_bin) %>%
    summarise(
      gpp_max = quantile(GPP, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
      vpd_mid = mean(VPD, na.rm = TRUE),
      n = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(n >= 3) %>%
    mutate(gpp_norm = gpp_max / max(gpp_max, na.rm = TRUE))
  
  vpd_at_peak <- binned$vpd_mid[which.max(binned$gpp_norm)]
  descending  <- binned %>% filter(vpd_mid >= vpd_at_peak)
  
  if (nrow(descending) < 3) {
    return(tibble(site = site, intercept = NA, slope = NA,
                  vpd_at_peak = NA, n_bins = nrow(descending)))
  }
  
  model <- lm(gpp_norm ~ vpd_mid, data = descending)
  coefs <- coef(model)
  
  tibble(
    site        = site,
    intercept   = coefs[1],
    slope       = coefs[2],
    vpd_at_peak = vpd_at_peak,
    n_bins      = nrow(descending)
  )
}) %>%
  mutate(site = str_remove(site, "_HH_daily"))  # this closing }) was also missing


# Step 2: Build point cloud — raw daily points normalised per site
all_clouds <- map_dfr(names(sites_daily_capped), function(site) {
  
  df <- sites_daily_capped[[site]]
  
  
gpp_max_site <- max(df$GPP, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  df %>%
    drop_na(VPD, GPP) %>%
    mutate(
      gpp_norm = GPP / gpp_max_site,
      site     = str_remove(site, "_HH_daily")
    ) %>%
    select(site, VPD, gpp_norm)
})


# Step 3: Build fitted lines from slopes + intercepts
fitted_lines <- site_slopes %>%
  filter(!is.na(slope)) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  reframe(
    site    = site,
    vpd_mid = seq(vpd_at_peak, 6, by = 0.1),
    fitted  = intercept + slope * vpd_mid
  )


# Step 4: Plot — cloud + slope line per site
site_names  <- unique(all_clouds$site)
site_groups <- split(site_names, ceiling(seq_along(site_names) / 6))

plots <- map(site_groups, function(sites_subset) {
  
  all_clouds %>%
    filter(site %in% sites_subset) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = VPD, y = gpp_norm)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.4, alpha = 0.2, colour = "grey40") +
    geom_line(data = filter(fitted_lines, site %in% sites_subset),
              aes(x = vpd_mid, y = fitted),
              colour = "firebrick", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_vline(data = filter(site_slopes, site %in% sites_subset),
               aes(xintercept = vpd_at_peak),
               linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.4) +
    facet_wrap(~ site, scales = "free_x", ncol = 2) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.5)) +
    labs(x = "VPD (kPa)", y = "Normalised GPP") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    theme(strip.background = element_blank(),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
})

walk(plots, print)

```

```{r}
sites_of_interest <- c("Asm", "Fog", "Cpr", "Das")

cloud_single <- all_clouds %>%
  filter(site %in% sites_of_interest)

lines_single <- fitted_lines %>%
  filter(site %in% sites_of_interest)

slopes_single <- site_slopes %>%
  filter(site %in% sites_of_interest)
```

```{r}
binned_single <- map_dfr(sites_of_interest, function(site) {
  
  df <- sites_daily_capped[[paste0(site)]]
  
  df %>%
    drop_na(VPD, GPP) %>%
    mutate(vpd_bin = cut(VPD, breaks = seq(0, 6, by = 0.2))) %>%
    group_by(vpd_bin) %>%
    summarise(
      vpd_mid = mean(VPD, na.rm = TRUE),
      gpp_95  = quantile(GPP, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      gpp_norm = gpp_95 / max(gpp_95, na.rm = TRUE),
      site = site
    )
})
```

```{r}
p_single <- ggplot() +
  
  # raw cloud
  geom_point(

  ) +

    data = binned_single,

    colour = "#0072B2",
```

```{r}
make_plot <- function(site_name) {
  
  cloud <- subset(cloud_single, site == site_name)
  binned <- subset(binned_single, site == site_name)
  lines  <- subset(lines_single, site == site_name)
  slopes <- subset(slopes_single, site == site_name)

  ggplot() +
    geom_point(
      data = cloud,
      aes(x = VPD, y = gpp_norm),
      colour = "grey60", alpha = 0.15, size = 0.5
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = lines,
      aes(x = vpd_mid, y = fitted),
      colour = "#EE6677", linewidth = 1.2
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      data = slopes,
      aes(xintercept = vpd_at_peak),
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.8
    ) +
   geom_text(
  data = slopes,
  aes(
    x = vpd_at_peak,
    y = 1.2,
    label = paste0("Threshold = ", round(vpd_at_peak, 2), " kPa")
  ),
  size = 3.5,
  hjust = -0.1
) +
geom_text(
  data = slopes,
  aes(
    x = vpd_at_peak,
    y = 1.1,
    label = paste0("Slope = ", round(slope, 2))
  ),
  size = 3.5,
  hjust = -0.1
) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.3)) +
    labs(
      x = "Vapour Pressure Deficit (kPa)",
      y = "Normalised GPP",
      title = site_name
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14)
}

p_fog <- make_plot("Fog")
p_asm <- make_plot("Asm")
p_das <- make_plot("Das")
p_cpr <- make_plot("Cpr")
```

```{r}
p_slope <- site_slopes_env %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(MAP, MAT),
    names_to  = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = value, y = slope, colour = Precip_regime)) +

    se        = TRUE,
    colour    = "grey30",

  geom_point(
    size  = 3,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +

    max.overlaps = 20,
    show.legend  = FALSE
  ) +
  
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = precip_colours,
    name   = "Precipitation regime"
  ) +
  
  facet_wrap(
    ~ variable,
    scales   = "free_x",
    labeller = as_labeller(env_labels)
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Post-peak GPP~VPD slope (β)"

  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    legend.position  = "none",
    legend.title     = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()

  guides(colour = guide_legend(
    nrow         = 2,
    override.aes = list(size = 4)
  ))

print(p_slope)
```

```{r}
model_stats <- site_slopes_env %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(MAT, MAP, MAL),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  do({
    model <- lm(slope ~ value, data = .)
    summary_model <- summary(model)
    
    tibble(
      R2 = summary_model$r.squared,
      p_value = coef(summary_model)[2, 4]
    )
  })

threshold_stats <- site_slopes_env %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(MAT, MAP, MAL),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  do({
    model <- lm(vpd_at_peak ~ value, data = .)
    summary_model <- summary(model)
    
    tibble(
      R2 = summary_model$r.squared,
      p_value = coef(summary_model)[2, 4]
    )
  })

model_stats$type <- "Slope"
threshold_stats$type <- "Threshold"

all_stats <- bind_rows(model_stats, threshold_stats)

print(all_stats)
```

```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 1: PREPARE SCALED MATRIX
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

slopes_mat <- site_slopes %>%
  filter(!is.na(slope), !is.na(vpd_at_peak)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("site") %>%
  select(slope, vpd_at_peak) %>%
  scale()

```

```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 2: ELBOW PLOT — find optimal k (for supplementary)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

set.seed(42)

wss <- map_dbl(1:8, function(k) {
  kmeans(slopes_mat, centers = k, nstart = 25, iter.max = 100)$tot.withinss
})

p_elbow <- tibble(k = 1:8, wss = wss) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = k, y = wss)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_point(size = 3, colour = "#4477AA") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 3, linetype = "dashed",
             colour = "#EE6677", linewidth = 0.6) +
  annotate("text", x = 3.15, y = max(wss) * 0.95,
           label = "k = 3 selected",
           hjust = 0, size = 3.5,
           colour = "#EE6677", fontface = "italic") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:8) +
  labs(
    x        = "Number of clusters (k)",
    y        = "Total within-cluster sum of squares",
    title    = "Elbow plot — k-means cluster selection",
    subtitle = "Slope and VPD threshold used as clustering variables"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "grey40", size = 9)
  )

print(p_elbow)  # save this to supplementary

```

```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 3: FIT K-MEANS WITH k = 3
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

set.seed(42)
km_fit <- kmeans(slopes_mat, centers = 3, nstart = 25, iter.max = 100)

# ── Assign raw cluster labels ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
site_slopes <- site_slopes %>%
  filter(!is.na(slope), !is.na(vpd_at_peak)) %>%
  mutate(cluster_raw = factor(km_fit$cluster))

# ── Order clusters by mean slope (most negative = High sensitivity) ───────────
cluster_order <- site_slopes %>%
  group_by(cluster_raw) %>%
  summarise(mean_slope = mean(slope), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(mean_slope) %>%          # most negative first = High
  mutate(cluster_multi = c("High", "Medium", "Low"))

site_slopes <- site_slopes %>%
  left_join(cluster_order %>% select(cluster_raw, cluster_multi),
            by = "cluster_raw") %>%
  mutate(cluster_multi = factor(cluster_multi,
                                levels = c("Low", "Medium", "High")))

# ── Sanity check ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
site_slopes %>%
  group_by(cluster_multi) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_slope     = round(mean(slope), 3),
    mean_threshold = round(mean(vpd_at_peak), 3),
    n              = n()
  )

```

```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 4: JOIN site_meta AND rebuild cloud/fitted objects
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

site_slopes <- site_slopes %>%
  left_join(site_meta, by = "site")

cluster_lookup  <- site_slopes %>% select(site, cluster_multi)
all_clouds_cl   <- all_clouds   %>% left_join(cluster_lookup, by = "site")
fitted_lines_cl <- fitted_lines %>% left_join(cluster_lookup, by = "site")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 5: THREE-PANEL CLUSTER SUMMARY PLOT
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

cluster_mean_params <- site_slopes %>%
  filter(!is.na(slope)) %>%
  group_by(cluster_multi) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_slope     = mean(slope,       na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_intercept = mean(intercept,   na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_vpd_peak  = mean(vpd_at_peak, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_sites        = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cluster_mean_lines <- cluster_mean_params %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  reframe(
    cluster_multi = cluster_multi,
    n_sites       = n_sites,
    mean_slope    = mean_slope,
    mean_vpd_peak = mean_vpd_peak,
    vpd_mid       = seq(mean_vpd_peak, 6, by = 0.05),
    fitted        = mean_intercept + mean_slope * vpd_mid
  )

cluster_labels <- cluster_mean_params %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(
      "n = ", n_sites, " sites\n",
      "Mean β = ", round(mean_slope, 3), "\n",
      "Mean VPD peak = ", round(mean_vpd_peak, 2), " kPa"
    )
  )

p_cluster_summary <- ggplot() +

  geom_point(
    data  = all_clouds_cl,
    aes(x = VPD, y = gpp_norm, colour = cluster_multi),
    size  = 0.3, alpha = 0.08
  ) +

  geom_line(
    data      = fitted_lines_cl,
    aes(x = vpd_mid, y = fitted, group = site, colour = cluster_multi),
    linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.35
  ) +

  geom_line(
    data      = cluster_mean_lines,
    aes(x = vpd_mid, y = fitted, colour = cluster_multi),
    linewidth = 1.5, alpha = 1
  ) +

  geom_vline(
    data     = cluster_mean_params,
    aes(xintercept = mean_vpd_peak, colour = cluster_multi),
    linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.8
  ) +

  geom_text(
    data        = cluster_labels,
    aes(label   = label, colour = cluster_multi),
    x           = Inf, y = Inf,
    hjust       = 1.1, vjust = 1.3,
    size        = 3.2, fontface = "bold",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  facet_wrap(
    ~ factor(cluster_multi, levels = c("Low", "Medium", "High")),
    ncol   = 3,
    scales = "free_x"
  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(values = cluster_colours) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.3)) +
  labs(x = "VPD (kPa)", y = "Normalised GPP") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    legend.position  = "none",
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey94", linewidth = 0.3)
  )

print(p_cluster_summary)
```

```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 6: BAR PLOTS — PFT, CLIMATE, PRECIP REGIME PER CLUSTER
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ── Helper function to avoid repeating bar plot code ─────────────────────────
make_bar_plot <- function(data, group_var, fill_colours, legend_title) {
  data %>%
    count(cluster_multi, {{ group_var }}) %>%
    group_by(cluster_multi) %>%
    mutate(
      prop          = n / sum(n),
      cluster_multi = factor(cluster_multi, levels = c("Low", "Medium", "High"))
    ) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = cluster_multi, y = prop, fill = {{ group_var }})) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = scales::percent(prop, accuracy = 1)),
      position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
      size     = 3,
      colour   = "white",
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = fill_colours, name = legend_title) +
    labs(x = "Sensitivity cluster", y = "Proportion of sites") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
      legend.text     = element_text(size = 8)
    )
}

# ── Check column names match your data ───────────────────────────────────────
# update "koppen", "PFT", "Precip_regime" if your columns are named differently
names(site_slopes)

p_pft     <- make_bar_plot(site_slopes, PFT,          pft_colours,    "PFT")
p_climate <- make_bar_plot(site_slopes, koppen,        climate_colours, "Climate")
p_precip  <- make_bar_plot(site_slopes, Precip_regime, precip_colours,  "Precipitation\nregime")

# ── Print individually ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
print(p_pft)
print(p_climate)
print(p_precip)
```

```{r}
site_map_data <- site_slopes %>%
  select(site, cluster_multi) %>%
  left_join(
    metrics_wide %>% select(site, R2_with_VPD),
    by = "site"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    site_meta %>% select(site, lat, lon),
    by = "site"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(lat), !is.na(lon), !is.na(R2_with_VPD)) %>%
  mutate(R2_with_VPD = pmax(R2_with_VPD, 0))  # clamp negative R² to 0

# Check it looks right
glimpse(site_map_data)
```

```{r}
  ) +

  # Continuous colour scale for R² — low = warm/red, high = cool/blue
scale_colour_gradientn(
    colours = c("#CC3311", "#EE8866", "#FFFFCC", "#6699CC", "#004488"),
    values  = scales::rescale(c(0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8)),
    limits  = c(0, 0.8),
    name    = expression(Model ~ R^2),
    breaks  = c(0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8),
    labels  = c("0.0\n(low)", "0.2", "0.4", "0.6", "0.8\n(high)"),

      barheight = 7,
      ticks     = TRUE
    )

  # Shape scale for sensitivity cluster
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(

    name = "VPD sensitivity"

  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(

    legend.text      = element_text(size = 9),

  ) +

  guides(
    shape  = guide_legend(
      order        = 1,
      override.aes = list(size = 4, colour = "grey30")
    ),
    colour = guide_colourbar(order = 2)
  )

print(p_map)
```

```{r}
# ── Install/load required packages ───────────────────────────────────────────
library(terra)
library(tidyterra)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# Load raster
koppen_rast <- rast("/Users/alicerolfe/year_4_project/fluxnet_project/Data/Beck_KG_V1_present_0p0083.tif")

# ── Step 2: Crop to Australia extent ─────────────────────────────────────────
aus_extent   <- ext(113, 154, -44, -10)
koppen_aus   <- crop(koppen_rast, aus_extent)

# ── Step 3: Define Köppen zone colours ───────────────────────────────────────
# Beck et al. use integer codes 1-30 for climate zones
# Below are the codes relevant to Australia with matched colours
# Full legend: https://www.nature.com/articles/sdata2018214


```

```{r}
# ── Simplified Köppen colour mapping ─────────────────────────────────────────
# Remap individual zone codes to broader categories first

koppen_categories <- c(
  "1"  = "Tropical",
  "2"  = "Tropical",
  "3"  = "Tropical",
  "4"  = "Desert",
  "5"  = "Desert",
  "6"  = "Semi-arid",
  "7"  = "Semi-arid",
  "14" = "Subtropical",
  "15" = "Temperate",
  "16" = "Temperate",
  "17" = "Temperate",
  "18" = "Temperate",
  "20" = "Subtropical",
  "21" = "Subtropical"
)

# Simplified colour palette — one colour per broad category
koppen_colours_simple <- c(
  "Tropical"    = "#FF8C00",
  "Desert"      = "#C8A45A",
  "Semi-arid"   = "#F0D080",
  "Subtropical" = "#90C060",
  "Temperate"   = "#4A90A0"
)

# ── Reclassify raster values to broad category codes ─────────────────────────
# Convert raster to dataframe, remap, then back to factor
koppen_df <- as.data.frame(koppen_aus, xy = TRUE) %>%
  rename(lon = x, lat = y, zone_code = 3) %>%
  mutate(
    zone_code    = as.character(zone_code),
    broad_zone   = koppen_categories[zone_code]
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(broad_zone))

# ── Build map ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_map_koppen <- ggplot() +

  # Simplified Köppen background
  geom_raster(
    data  = koppen_df,
    aes(x = lon, y = lat, fill = broad_zone),
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values   = koppen_colours_simple,
    name     = "Köppen climate",
    na.value = "grey90",
    guide    = guide_legend(
      ncol         = 1,
      keywidth     = 0.8,
      keyheight    = 0.6,
      override.aes = list(alpha = 1)
    )
  ) +

  # Australia border
  geom_sf(
    data      = australia_sf,
    fill      = NA,
    colour    = "grey30",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +

  # Site points — R² as colour, cluster as shape, no labels
  geom_point(
    data  = site_map_data,
    aes(x      = lon,
        y      = lat,
        colour = R2_with_VPD,
        shape  = cluster_multi),
    size  = 4,
    alpha = 0.95
  ) +

  # R² colour scale
  scale_colour_gradientn(
    colours = c("#CC3311", "#EE8866", "#FFFFCC", "#6699CC", "#004488"),
    values  = scales::rescale(c(0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8)),
    limits  = c(0, 0.8),
    name    = expression(Model ~ R^2),
    breaks  = c(0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8),
    labels  = c("0.0", "0.2", "0.4", "0.6", "0.8"),
    guide   = guide_colourbar(
      barwidth  = 0.8,
      barheight = 6,
      ticks     = TRUE,
      order     = 2
    )
  ) +

  # Cluster shape scale
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Low"    = 16,
      "Medium" = 17,
      "High"   = 8
    ),
    name  = "VPD sensitivity",
    guide = guide_legend(
      order        = 3,
      override.aes = list(size = 4, colour = "grey10")
    )
  ) +

  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(113, 154),
    ylim = c(-44, -10)
  ) +

  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +

  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "right",
    legend.title     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.spacing.y = unit(0.3, "cm"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#d6eaf8", colour = NA)
  )

print(p_map_koppen)

```
